thread:
maria: quick thought — should we expose a tiny pin hint in the public API so clients can show which model variant is sticky and an approximate TTL?
kevin: worried about leaking rollout labels. what do clients actually need to surface?
sophia: typically: a human-friendly variant name, an advisory ttl in seconds, and whether its a hard pin or a soft preference. no infra ids.
jon: opt-in only. maybe an opt-in response field or header so older clients ignore it.
maria: proposal: request header `X-Redwood-Pin-View: true` enables the server to include a compact pin_hint in the JSON response. default off.
kevin: tenant-level enable in console + per-request header. avoids accidental leaks.
sophia: payload shape: keep it tiny and stable. we could do a compact k/v string: `v1|n:gpt-mini|t:3600|m:soft`. base64-url encode to keep it transport-safe.
jon: base64 makes it opaque; clients can decode if they want. also we should version it (`v1`) to allow changes.
maria: alternative: TLV-esque ascii with pipes is easier to parse without JSON libs. but encode anyway to avoid collisions in response.
kevin: security: unsigned tokens are display-only. consider optional signing when tenant wants a verifiable badge. use tenant-managed signing key for signed blobs.
sophia: signed vs unsigned: default unsigned (simpler). console toggle can enable signed mode; signed mode emits `pin_hint_sig` header or includes a signature suffix.
jon: redaction policy: if a rollout uses private tags or tenant-overrides that would reveal infra mapping, omit the pin_hint entirely rather than returning a redacted token. simpler for clients.
maria: agreed. in logs/telemetry we emit a reason code (ops-only) when pin_hint omitted for privacy.
kevin: also document: TTL is advisory only. model can be rebound earlier. clients must not make security decisions based on this field.
sophia: example response when enabled:
```json
{"pin_hint":"djEgfG46Z3B0LW1pbml8dDozNjAwfG06c29mdA=="}
```
jon: decoding that gives `v1|n:gpt-mini|t:3600|m:soft`. simple.
maria: follow-ups: write a short RFC blurb describing header opt-in, payload encoding, signed mode, and redaction policy; add console UX copy for tenant toggle; add unit/integration tests for omission and signed verification.
deploy-bot: staging: feature-flag `compact-pin-view` ON for team:acme-staging. :rocket:
kevin: also add server-side lint that ensures we never include private tenant ids in the name field. enforce through schema validators.
sophia: UX: show friendly name plus "~1h" tooltip. if missing, show nothing.
jon: i'll draft a tiny reference implementation for decoding and verifying signed blobs in the SDKs.
maria: i'll author the RFC and drop a link in this thread when ready. thanks folks :thumbsup:
